strongest_objection: The seriation's second thread, what must register the exercise for the spend to occur, is misassigned at both ends of the walk, and at the closing hinge the misassignment is a false mechanism. Alpha spent by the trade is declared 'its own register, since no observer is needed', and the seriation note builds the hinge on 'the price itself, with no audience'; but price impact that lasts is the other side of the book inferring information from the order flow, the mechanical part from eating the book refills as liquidity returns, slicing and dark venues exist precisely to hide the flow from readers, and the map's own edge Alpha → Pattern in the visits names 'a counterparty who reads the series'. At the opening, Never asked is said to have 'no register but the holder's own count', yet the item concedes that a counterparty's turnover loses the count, so the register is the counterparty's memory, the same register as Lever that tags the hand, and the neighbor test below shows the two are mirror-close on exactly that ground. Both items survive once their registers are named, and the axis survives read as the smallest exercise that registers: an ask of any size at the start, an exercise large enough to wake a rule-maker or fund an entrant at the end. I tried to collapse Never asked into Exception cited back (the map's own step edge says they are priced alike) and could not, since one is the asker's record and the other the grantor's discretion, and the price falls on the holder's next ask in one and on the holder's next refusal in the other. No item restates status-conversions or power-trades: Never asked bills the asker where Introducer's tab bills a third party, Sword that drops the shield is a side effect where Queen for a day is a trade, and Lever that tags the hand adds an exercise price that Veto sold as an improbability does not carry.

items.item: Never asked: an advantage that consists in a count of zero is spent whole by the first exercise, whatever its size, since 'I have never asked you for anything' is a sentence with one use, as the founder who telephones the customer's chief executive directly once, the supplier that has never invoked force majeure, the ally who calls in the debt from the war; the condition spent is the clean record, which becomes a count of one, so that the second ask is priced against the first rather than against the record; it does not regenerate, since no length of not asking again returns the count to zero, though a counterparty's turnover can lose the count; the mark is that the sentence can no longer be said, and a counterparty who hears 'I rarely ask' knows it has been said before; not status-conversions' Introducer's tab, where each introduction is billed to the introducer at a rate, since here the first exercise carries almost the whole price and the tenth almost none, and the bill is the asker's own.
items.why: In type and distinct: the condition spent is a binary predicate on the relationship's record, consumed by any instance, and the mark (the sentence that can no longer be said) is observable. The 'whatever its size' clause is a folk claim and the mode statement says so; leave it marked. Not a restatement of status-conversions' Introducer's tab, which bills a third party per introduction at a rate; here the bill is the asker's own and steps at one. But the item's own regeneration clause, that a counterparty's turnover loses the count, shows the register is the counterparty's memory and not, as the of-sentence and seriation say, 'no register but the holder's own count'; see seriation.

items.item: Sword that drops the shield: an advantage held as a protection is spent when the protected matter is used as a weapon, as the defendant who pleads advice of counsel waives privilege over the advice and the file behind it, and the witness who testifies on a subject opens that subject to cross-examination; the condition spent is that the protected matter was never put in issue by its own holder, and it becomes discoverable material in the counterparty's hands; it does not regenerate for that subject, and the holder often learns it was spent only at the motion to compel, weeks after the pleading that spent it; the mark is the waiver ruling and the production that follows; not power-trades' Queen for a day, where the exclusivity of a fact is traded for immunity in a letter struck before the fact is spoken, since here nothing is traded and the spend is a side effect of an exercise the holder priced as free.
items.why: In type on a strict reading: the file is one holding with two uses, and exercising the sword use consumes the condition (never put in issue) that made the shield use work. Mark and non-regeneration are right. Not a restatement of power-trades' Queen for a day: that is exclusivity consumed inside a trade struck before the telling; here nothing is traded and the holder priced the exercise as free. The ledger's rejection of Told once on the same ground is consistent.

items.item: Ruling that prices the patent: an advantage held in the uncertainty of a right's scope is spent by testing it, as the unlitigated patent that licensees pay to avoid finding out about, and the untested termination clause the counterparty settles rather than construes; the condition spent is the uncertainty, which becomes a claim-construction order or a judgment, and even the win narrows, since a court that upholds a claim says what it covers and every future defendant reads the boundary; it does not regenerate for that right, though a continuation application can grow a new uncertain claim beside it; the mark is the order itself and a licensing rate that steps on the day it issues, up or down; not ghost-leverages' threat of suit under a statute already repealed, a dead power still obeyed, since here the power is live and the exercise reveals its exact size to everyone who will ever face it.
items.why: Distinct mechanism (uncertainty spent by testing, with the win narrowing too), an observable mark (the order and the rate step), and a real regeneration route (continuation). 'Every future defendant reads the boundary' is right as reads, and would be wrong as bound; leave as written.

items.item: Novelty in the book: an advantage held in an opponent's unpreparedness is spent by one exercise in a venue that records, as the chess player's prepared novelty that enters every database the evening it is played and the trick play that is on the opposing staff's film by Monday; the condition spent is the idea's absence from the record, which becomes theory every future opponent has read; it does not regenerate for that idea, and the holder's stock regenerates only by preparing the next; the mark is the annotation in the database and, after it, a second showing that meets a prepared reply; the holder's control is the venue, since the same idea in an unrecorded game is not spent, which is why novelties are kept for the opponent and the round that matter; not Zero-day, spent by the target's own forensic reading, since here the target may never understand the idea and it is spent anyway by whoever reads the record.
items.why: Distinct from Zero-day by register (the record's readers, not the target's forensics) and the item says why the venue is the holder's control. Sound.

items.item: Zero-day: an advantage held in a maker's ignorance of a flaw is spent by the exploit's use, because the exploit carries its own description onto the target's machine, where the target or its vendor can read it; the condition spent is the maker's ignorance, which becomes a patch, and the exploit's price falls from the price of an unknown flaw to the price of an unpatched population; it does not regenerate for that flaw, and the holder's stock regenerates only by finding another; the mark is the advisory and the patch date, and the trade's word for a spent exploit is burned; not Burned source, where the exercise spends the condition only if the action cannot be otherwise explained, since here the exercise is the description and no cover is available, only a target chosen for not looking.
items.why: Sound as a mechanism and the trade's own word is the mark. One incompleteness worth knowing rather than repairing: a flaw can also be registered by the vendor's crash telemetry with no forensics on the target, so 'a target chosen for not looking' is not a full cover; the item's own rule (the exploit carries its description) already implies this.

items.item: Burned source: an advantage held in a stream of the counterparty's own communications is spent by any action that only the stream could explain, as the wartime convoy attacks based on decrypts that were preceded by a reconnaissance aircraft so the enemy could credit the aircraft, and the informant whose reports must not be acted on so exactly that only he could have told; the condition spent is the counterparty's belief that its channel is secure, which becomes a rekeyed cipher and a hunt for the leak; it does not regenerate for that source; the mark is the counterparty's procedure changing, which the holder sees as the stream going dark; the holder's control is explicability, so the exercise is rationed not by count but by whether a cover for each action exists, and the most valuable action is the one that cannot be covered; not Novelty in the book, spent by a record anyone can read, since here the register is the counterparty's own inference and an action that looks like luck leaves the source intact.
items.why: The strongest item on the map: the spend is rationed by explicability rather than count, and the most valuable action is the uncoverable one. The cover-flight practice is documented and the mode statement marks the simplification.

items.item: Image shown down: an advantage held in a counterparty's model of the holder is spent only if the exercise is revealed, as the tight player's bluff, which wins because of the image and destroys the image at showdown; the condition spent is the model, which becomes its opposite, a loose image that the counterparty can exploit and the holder can exploit in the other direction; it regenerates with a new table, or with time and a run of exercises that confirm the old model; the mark is the calls that come afterward; the holder can fold before the showdown and the counterparty's own fold keeps the image intact, so exercise without spend is available and the spend is made by the counterparty's decision to look; not Zero-day, where the revelation is in the target's hands, since here it is in the holder's hands until the last card.
items.why: Distinct by the fold: exercise without spend is available and the counterparty's call is the decision to look. A called bluff mucked unshown still spends the image, since the muck concedes the hand had nothing, so the mechanism holds either way.

items.item: Flaming datum: an advantage held in the counterparty's ignorance of where the holder is is spent by any exercise that can be traced, as the submarine whose torpedo hands the escorts a bearing, the sniper whose shot marks the hide, and the quiet acquirer whose first bid tells the market what it wants; the condition spent is the unknown position, which becomes a known one and a search centered on it; it regenerates by moving, at the cost of time and of the exposure the move itself risks, which is why the doctrine is one shot and relocate; the mark is the return fire, or in the market the price of everything the acquirer is now known to want; not Burned source, where what is spent is the counterparty's channel and no move restores it, since here the holder regenerates the condition by its own act.
items.why: Mechanism, condition, and mark are right for the submarine and the sniper, but the third case, the quiet acquirer's first bid, cannot use the item's regeneration clause: an acquirer does not relocate. The repair completes the regeneration column for that case (a hand the market does not yet know is the acquirer's) so the case fits the item it sits in.
items.repair: Flaming datum: an advantage held in the counterparty's ignorance of where the holder is is spent by any exercise that can be traced, as the submarine whose torpedo hands the escorts a bearing, the sniper whose shot marks the hide, and the quiet acquirer whose first bid tells the market what it wants; the condition spent is the unknown position, which becomes a known one and a search centered on it; it regenerates by moving, at the cost of time and of the exposure the move itself risks, which is why the doctrine is one shot and relocate, and the acquirer, who cannot move, regenerates it only by bidding through a hand the market does not yet know is its own; the mark is the return fire, or in the market the price of everything the acquirer is now known to want; not Burned source, where what is spent is the counterparty's channel and no move restores it, since here the holder regenerates the condition by its own act.

items.item: Pattern in the visits: an advantage held in the unpredictability of an exercise is spent by no single exercise and by the series, as the surprise inspection that after four Tuesdays is expected on the fifth, the audit whose sampling rule has been inferred, the raid whose timing follows payroll; the condition spent is the target's inability to prepare, which becomes a schedule the target keeps better than the inspector does; it regenerates by randomization, which costs the holder its own planning and its staff's convenience; the mark is the site that is clean on inspection day and not the day after, a pattern the holder can see only by breaking its own; not Novelty in the book, spent by one recorded showing, since here each showing is free and the spend is a property of the sequence.
items.why: Distinct: each showing is free and the spend belongs to the sequence. The convergence point of the map, and both incoming edges earn it.

items.item: Tolerance: an advantage held in a receiver's naivety is spent by the dose, as the receptor that desensitizes under a repeated agonist so the same dose does less, and the audience that stops flinching at the alarm; the condition spent is the receiver's sensitivity, which becomes tolerance and, when the dose stops, an overshoot in the other direction; it regenerates with abstinence, on the receiver's clock and not the holder's; the mark is the escalating dose, which is the only number the holder can see; not Resistance bred, spent across a population by selection, since here the receiver is one body and the condition comes back if left alone; not stamina, since the thing spent is not the holder's supply but the target's response.
items.why: One body, regenerates by abstinence on the receiver's clock, rebound when the dose stops: sound. Shares the alarm case with Tier above; they separate on replacing the receiver, since a fresh guard flinches at the alarm the veterans ignore (tolerance lived in the body) while a fresh reader inherits the discount on 'urgent' from the record (the tier lived in the base rate). Both stay.

items.item: Resistance bred: an advantage over a population is spent by selection, as the antibiotic that leaves the survivors, the pesticide, and the phishing template that survives only in the inboxes trained on it; the condition spent is the population's susceptibility, which becomes a resistant population and a drug moved to the reserve list; it regenerates only where resistance carries a fitness cost and the exercise is withdrawn long enough, and sometimes not at all; the mark is the rising concentration needed for the same effect, measured across the population rather than the patient; the condition is a commons, so any holder's exercise spends every holder's condition and one holder's restraint preserves nothing, which is why stewardship is a rule and not a choice; not risk-rebound-effects' The antibiotic bequest, which names the successor risk the mitigation breeds, since here the point is the shape of the spend, that the condition is shared and the regeneration is on the pathogen's clock.
items.why: Distinct from Tolerance by level and regeneration clock, and the only item that names its condition as a commons. The fitness-cost regeneration claim and the phishing analogy are marked in the mode statement. Not risk-rebound-effects' antibiotic bequest, which names the successor risk; here the shape of the spend.

items.item: Exception cited back: an advantage held in discretion, the power to grant or refuse, is spent by the grant, because the grant is the next petitioner's precedent, as the end-of-quarter discount that teaches the buyer when to buy, the covenant breach waived three times that the borrower pleads as course of dealing, and the exception for one employee that becomes the policy; the condition spent is the unbound choice, which becomes a schedule the counterparty can read; it regenerates only by a distinguishing that costs the holder credibility or by a counterparty who has not seen the record; the mark is the anti-waiver clause, the paper by which lenders try to grant without spending, and the quarter-end spike in bookings; the spend reaches only the counterparty that saw the grant unless a carrier moves the record, a most-favored-nation clause, a union, a reporter; not deal-deaths' Concession-made option, where a concession reveals a need and manufactures the other side's alternative, since here the grant reveals nothing and binds by being repeated.
items.why: Distinct mechanism (discretion spent by the grant that becomes precedent), an observable mark (the anti-waiver clause, the quarter-end spike), a scoping rule (reaches only who saw it unless a carrier moves the record). Not deal-deaths' Concession-made option, since no alternative is manufactured; the grant binds by being repeated.

items.item: Lever that tags the hand: an advantage held in a counterparty's presumption that one would not use a power against it is spent by using it, as the employee who takes the counteroffer and is thereafter a flight risk, and the investor who blocks the sale under a protective provision and is thereafter the investor who blocks sales; the condition spent is the presumption of alignment, which becomes a tag; it regenerates only with the turnover of the people who remember; the mark is the succession plan started quietly, the reference call that goes badly, the allocation not offered; adds to power-trades' Veto sold as an improbability the exercise price, which is not the deal blocked but the deals not offered, paid in the market where the power was allocated; not status-conversions' Cashing out, where standing is sold for money, since here standing is spent as a side effect of an exercise that was not a sale.
items.why: Distinct from Never asked (see neighbor test) and not a restatement of power-trades' Veto sold as an improbability, which prices the veto at the trade and finds it one-sided from the founder's side; this item adds the investor's own exercise price, the allocations not offered, which power-trades does not carry. Not status-conversions' Cashing out, which is a sale. Stays.

items.item: Slack shown to the budget: an advantage held in a reserve nobody has counted is spent by the first draw on it that a principal sees, as the surge beds staffed on an ordinary Tuesday that appear in next year's bed count, the contingency line spent on the schedule that becomes next year's schedule, the engineer's hidden week of buffer that the manager learns of and removes; the condition spent is the reserve's invisibility, which becomes a line item; it regenerates only by building a new reserve above the new baseline and hiding it better; the mark is the next budget, where the reserve appears as capacity; not Tolerance, spent by a target's adaptation, since here the party that takes the reserve is the holder's own principal, and the exercise is spent not by an adversary but by being seen from above.
items.why: A strange member that survives: the register is the holder's own principal and the mark is next year's budget line. In type, since the exercise (the draw) consumes the reserve's invisibility, not the reserve.

items.item: Tier above: an advantage held in a signal's rarity is spent by each use, as the priority flag, the urgent subject line, the superlative in the reference letter, and the honorific; the condition spent is the base rate against which the signal is read, which becomes a higher base rate and then decoration; it regenerates only by minting a rank above, the severity zero above the severity one, the new honorific, the word coined to replace the euphemism that has taken on its referent; the mark is the count of tiers, which records how many times the signal has been spent as a tree's rings record winters, an instance of clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Ratchet count; not risk-rebound-effects' The alarm fatigue, the sensitivity raised until the true alarm arrives pre-ignored, since here the spender is each sender and the regeneration is by a new tier that starts rare and is spent the same way.
items.why: Distinct from Tolerance (see that item) and from risk-rebound-effects' alarm fatigue, with a clean mark (the count of tiers) and a regeneration route (a rank above). Note for the seed rather than a repair: the rarity is a commons among senders, so this item and Loophole with a name share Resistance bred's shape without saying so.

items.item: Alpha spent by the trade: an advantage held in knowing where a price will go is spent by the trade that uses it, because the trade moves the price toward the knowledge, so the exercise realizes the advantage and consumes it in one motion and in proportion to its size; the condition spent is the price's ignorance, which becomes the price; it regenerates only with new information; the mark is the price impact, and the trader who sees it slices the order and hides it in dark venues to spend the condition slowly enough to collect more of it; the exercise is its own register, since no observer is needed for the spend and the holder wants it; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, spent past a threshold, since here every unit of exercise spends its own unit of condition and the holder chooses the rate.
items.why: The item's mechanism is right (the trade realizes and consumes the alpha in one motion, in proportion to size, and the holder wants the spend) but its register claim is false: 'no observer is needed' is contradicted by market microstructure and by the map's own edge to Pattern in the visits, which names 'a counterparty who reads the series'. Impact that lasts is the other side of the book inferring information from order flow; the mechanical part from eating the book refills as liquidity returns. Slicing and dark venues exist precisely to hide the flow from readers, which the item cites as if it supported self-registration. The repair names the register as the order flow read by whoever fills it, keeps the 'holder wants the spend' insight, and drops the no-observer clause.
items.repair: Alpha spent by the trade: an advantage held in knowing where a price will go is spent by the trade that uses it, because the trade moves the price toward the knowledge, so the exercise realizes the advantage and consumes it in one motion and in proportion to its size; the condition spent is the price's ignorance, which becomes the price; it regenerates only with new information; the mark is the price impact, of which the part that eats the book refills as liquidity returns and the part the other side infers from the flow stays, and the trader who sees it slices the order and hides it in dark venues to spend the condition slowly enough to collect more of it; the register is the order flow itself, read by whoever fills it, so the spend needs no record, no forensics, and no cover, only a counterparty on the other side of the book, and the holder wants the spend, since the spend is the realization; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, spent past a threshold, since here every unit of exercise spends its own unit of condition and the holder chooses the rate.

items.item: Loophole with a name: an advantage held in a rule-maker's inattention is spent by exercise at a scale the rule-maker notices, as the tax structure that works until enough firms use it that the rule closing it carries the practice's name, as the anti-Morris-Trust rules carry the structure they ended, and the arbitrage across two regulators closed by a memorandum between them; the condition spent is inattention, which becomes a rule; it regenerates as the next gap, never as this one; the mark is the rule's name, and the practice taught afterward in the course on what used to work; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, where a rival is funded by the margin, since here no one competes for the gap and the responder is the party whose inattention was the condition.
items.why: Distinct from Ruling that prices the patent by who chooses the test (the rule-maker wakes at aggregate scale; the patentee chooses to sue) and from Umbrella by who answers. The anti-Morris-Trust case is documented. Like Tier above, the inattention is a commons spent by every user's exercise, which the item leaves to the seed.

items.item: Umbrella that funds the entrant: an advantage held in a sole position is spent by pricing to it, because the margin above the entrant's cost is what pays the entrant's qualification, as the incumbent supplier whose price makes the buyer's second source worth qualifying, the drug whose price funds the generic's patent challenge, and the sanctioned party's dependency, priced by the sanction into a payment rail of its own; the condition spent is the absence of a rival worth building, which becomes a rival; it regenerates rarely, and only by the rival's failure; the mark is the second name on the approved-vendor list and the volume it takes, which the incumbent will not recover by cutting price; the spend is a threshold, so exercise below the entrant's cost is free forever and exercise above it is fatal once; not walkaway-manufactures' Qualified on paper, the buyer's certificate, since here the certificate is read from the incumbent's side as the mark that the price went past the line.
items.why: An analytical reading of limit pricing, marked as such, with a public mark (the second name on the vendor list) and a threshold shape that the walk needs at its close. 'Fatal once' overstates for a case where the entrant fails, which the regeneration clause already allows; the sanctions clause is compressed to the edge of legibility but the mode statement flags it as speculative, so it stays as marked.

neighbor_test.left: Never asked: an advantage that consists in a count of zero is spent whole by the first exercise, whatever its size, since 'I have never asked you for anything' is a sentence with one use, as the founder who telephones the customer's chief executive directly once, the supplier that has never invoked force majeure, the ally who calls in the debt from the war; the condition spent is the clean record, which becomes a count of one, so that the second ask is priced against the first rather than against the record; it does not regenerate, since no length of not asking again returns the count to zero, though a counterparty's turnover can lose the count; the mark is that the sentence can no longer be said, and a counterparty who hears 'I rarely ask' knows it has been said before; not status-conversions' Introducer's tab, where each introduction is billed to the introducer at a rate, since here the first exercise carries almost the whole price and the tenth almost none, and the bill is the asker's own.
neighbor_test.right: Lever that tags the hand: an advantage held in a counterparty's presumption that one would not use a power against it is spent by using it, as the employee who takes the counteroffer and is thereafter a flight risk, and the investor who blocks the sale under a protective provision and is thereafter the investor who blocks sales; the condition spent is the presumption of alignment, which becomes a tag; it regenerates only with the turnover of the people who remember; the mark is the succession plan started quietly, the reference call that goes badly, the allocation not offered; adds to power-trades' Veto sold as an improbability the exercise price, which is not the deal blocked but the deals not offered, paid in the market where the power was allocated; not status-conversions' Cashing out, where standing is sold for money, since here standing is spent as a side effect of an exercise that was not a sale.
neighbor_test.separating_case: Two employees, same employer, same raise. The first asks for it once, having never asked for anything; the raise is granted, and the next ask is priced against this one, the mark being that 'I have never asked' can no longer be said; nothing about the employee's disposition changed in the employer's model, and no allocation is withheld. The second brings an outside offer and takes the counteroffer; the raise is granted, and the presumption that this employee would not leave is spent, the mark being the succession plan started quietly and the project not offered, while 'I have never asked for a raise' remains true. Same size of exercise, same register (the employer's memory, lost by turnover in both), same spend-whole-at-one; what separates them is the condition spent, a count of restraint against a model of alignment, and where the price lands, on the holder's next ask against the counterparty's next offer. They do not collapse, but the case shows both are registered by the counterparty's memory, which is why the seriation's opening claim of 'no register but the holder's own count' is wrong.

boundary_case: The central bank defending a currency peg. It is tempting because the defense visibly spends two things at once: reserves, and the market's belief that the bank will hold. The reserves are the advantage's own supply, money by another name, and out by the map's fence. The belief is a condition beside the supply, and it is consumed only if the defense fails or is seen to be cheap, which is Image shown down exactly: if the speculators fold, the image is intact and the exercise cost nothing but the interest on the reserves, and the spend is made by the counterparty's decision to keep pressing until the showdown. Ruling: out for the reserves, in for the belief, and the in-part already has its item, so the case adds no member and confirms the fence, that what exercise consumes beside its own supply is in and the supply itself is not.

seriation.note: Keep the order; correct the reading. The itinerary is defensible as a single axis only if it is read as the smallest exercise that registers: an ask of any size (Never asked), one exercise in a recording venue or on a logging machine or in an inexplicable act or at a showdown, one traceable act, a series, a dose, a grant, a use, each unit of flow, and at the close an exercise past a scale that wakes a rule-maker or funds an entrant. The register thread as written runs least (holder's own count) to most to least (its own register), which is not an axis, and both endpoint claims are wrong on the items' own text: Never asked is registered by the counterparty's memory (its turnover clause says so), and Alpha is registered by the other side of the book reading the flow (its own edge says so). The note's hinge sentence, 'the alpha's in the price itself, with no audience', should say that the audience is whoever fills the order and needs no record, no forensics, and no cover, which is still a real contrast with Tier above's base rate that must be learned from the record. The of-sentence clause 'with no register but the holder's own count' should read 'registered by the counterparty's memory alone'. Two adjacencies are stronger than the note claims: Novelty in the book → Zero-day (record's readers against target's forensics) is genuinely consequential, and Exception cited back's step edge back to Never asked reveals them as asker's and grantor's mirrors. One dimension the walk does not carry cuts across it: Resistance bred, Tier above, and Loophole with a name are all spends of a commons, where any holder's exercise spends every holder's condition, and only the first says so.

edges.why: A real conditional whose antecedent fails whenever the target keeps forensics, and it draws the passage from a register on the file system to a register in inference. The antecedent should be read as 'no one on the target's or the vendor's side looks', since crash telemetry can register a flaw without the target; the label holds.

The fork's condition (does the exercise work unseen?) is a real claim that fails for a bluff and holds for a counteroffer, and it is the only edge the fork needs; the other arm is the fold inside Image shown down itself.
Conditional on the moves following an inferable rule, which they need not; it is one of the two edges that make the convergence at Pattern in the visits real.

The antecedent is real (slicing makes a series) but the consequent is wrong in its comparison: 'spends the condition faster than the single block would have' cannot hold, since a block spends it at once. What a read series does is hand the rest of the move to the reader ahead of the remaining slices, so the alpha is spent for someone else. The label also names the reader that the item text denies, which is why the item is repaired above.
edges.repair_label: If the holder slices the order to spend the price's ignorance slowly, the slices make a series, and a counterparty who reads the series takes the rest of the move ahead of the remaining slices, so the rationing that preserves the alpha is what creates the pattern that hands it to a reader; the block spent the condition at once, but into the holder's own fills.

edges.why: Conditional on reproduction under the dose, which fails for a receptor and holds for a pathogen; the passage between levels and the change of regeneration clock are both real consequences.

Conditional on a holder that has never granted; the claim that the first grant is priced as the first ask is real and its consequence (the decision is whether to become a party that gives) is an inference the pile did not support. It also shows Never asked and Exception cited back are mirror images, asker's and grantor's, registered in the same counterparty's memory.

Conditional on a narrow upholding, which fails on invalidation or a broad construction; the inversion (the win draws the entrant's line) is a real claim about design-around, and the closing phrase 'the uncertainty spent in court is the margin the umbrella can no longer keep' is a fair reading, not a mechanism claim.

modality_problems: Alpha spent by the trade: 'the exercise is its own register, since no observer is needed for the spend' is a false mechanism. Lasting price impact is informational, that is, the other side of the book inferring from order flow; mechanical impact from eating the book refills. Repaired.

Of-sentence and seriation: 'a first exercise that spends it whole with no register but the holder's own count' is contradicted by Never asked's own turnover clause; the register is the counterparty's memory. Corrected in the seriation note; the of-sentence clause should follow.
Seriation note's hinge: 'the alpha's in the price itself, with no audience' is the same error as the first; the audience is whoever fills the order.

Edge Alpha → Pattern in the visits: 'spends the condition faster than the single block would have' is impossible as stated; a block spends at once. Repaired to 'hands the rest of the move to a reader'.
Flaming datum: the acquirer case cannot use the item's regeneration clause (an acquirer does not relocate). Repaired by completing the regeneration column for that case.
Never asked: 'whatever its size' is a folk claim stated as a mechanism; the mode statement and the wild priority already say so, so it stays marked rather than repaired.

Umbrella that funds the entrant: 'exercise above it is fatal once' overstates against the item's own 'regenerates by the rival's failure'; the sanctions clause is speculative and marked in the mode statement but stated flat in the item. Left as marked.

Left as written; the item's own rule implies it.
